name: Which accessibility features should be prioritized in a granny suite design?
description: Prioritize curbless walk-in showers, wider doorways, slip-resistant flooring, lever handles, and reinforced wall backing for secure grab bar installation.

mainEntity.name: Which accessibility features should be prioritized in a granny suite design?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prioritizing universal design elements ensures the suite remains safe, comfortable, and functional for aging relatives over the long term. A zero-threshold walk-in shower or tub-to-shower conversion is a critical feature, eliminating tripping hazards associated with standard tubs. Other valuable additions include wider door frames to accommodate mobility aids, lever-style door and faucet handles, slip-resistant bathroom floor tile, and reinforced drywall blocking behind walls to securely mount grab bars. Ensuring zero-step transitions between rooms also helps maintain daily ease of movement and long-term independence.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prioritize curbless walk-in showers, wider doorways, slip-resistant flooring, lever handles, and reinforced wall backing for secure grab bar installation.
